verdict.rationale: Invoicing and accounts receivable is a fair axis for a small-business bookkeeping and accounting service, so the story applies. The evidence covers bookkeeping, categorization, reporting, banking and tax, but nothing shows Bench creating or sending invoices, offering online payment options, or tracking when invoices are viewed or paid. Working inside a customer's QuickBooks Online account is a host-platform capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid
